_nota: Dati del sito Visa Income Checker. Solo fonti ufficiali lette il giorno indicato (controllato_il, http = risposta del server). Gli importi si calcolano da 'base' (indice ufficiale o importo fisso) x 'fattore'. Regole per i familiari in 'famiglia': tipo 'tutti' (primo familiare / altri, qualunque età), 'per_eta' (adulto oltre il richiedente / figlio), 'figli' (solo figli: primo / altri), 'nessuno' (la regola non fissa importi per i familiari: si spiega perché). 'tetto' = importo massimo totale in unità della base. Da ricontrollare ogni gennaio: vedi NOTE.md.

programmi.nome_ufficiale: Visado / autorización de residencia para teletrabajo de carácter internacional
programmi.reddito: Income from remote work for companies outside Spain (the rule says 'a monthly amount', it does not say net or gross).
programmi.descrizione: Spain's visa and residence permit for international teleworkers (Law 14/2013 as amended by Law 28/2022).

varianti.regola: 200% of the SMI for the main applicant; 75% of the SMI for the first family member; 25% of the SMI for each further family member.

note: We apply the percentages to the annual SMI divided by 12 (€17,094 ÷ 12 = €1,424.50), the basis the Spanish consulate in Santiago de Chile refers to (it quotes the SMI in annual terms). Some offices may apply 200% to the €1,221 paid 14 times a year (= €2,442 a month): ask your consulate which basis it uses.
Family members are the spouse or partner and children; the 75% applies to the first one, 25% to each of the others.
You must also show that your remote work relationship has existed for at least 3 months, plus qualifications or 3 years' experience, health insurance and a clean criminal record.

fonti.titolo: Preguntas frecuentes – Autorizaciones de residencia y trabajo de teletrabajadores internacionales (question 19)
fonti.editore: Unidad de Grandes Empresas y Colectivos Estratégicos, Ministry of Inclusion
fonti.nota: Holders: monthly 200% of the SMI; household of two (holder + family member): at least 75% of the SMI; 25% of the SMI for each further member.

fonti.titolo: Requisitos visado de teletrabajo de carácter internacional (TEL)
fonti.editore: Consulate General of Spain in Santiago de Chile
fonti.nota: 200% of the SMI for the applicant, 75% for the first family member, 25% for each further one; the SMI is quoted in gross annual terms (its 2023 example is out of date).

programmi.nome_ufficiale: Autorización de residencia temporal no lucrativa
programmi.reddito: Funds or regular income (pensions, rents, investments); you may not work in Spain.
programmi.descrizione: Residence without working, for people who live on savings, a pension or passive income (Royal Decree 1155/2024, article 62).

varianti.regola: 400% of the IPREM a month for the main applicant, plus 100% of the IPREM a month for each family member in your care.

note: The law asks for the monthly amount for the whole period of the permit (the first permit lasts one year): 12 × €2,400 = €28,800 for one person.
You can show either funds available for the period or a regular income; the consulate assesses the documents.
Family members are the spouse or partner and children (minor, or adult and unable to support themselves).

fonti.titolo: Real Decreto 1155/2024, Reglamento de la Ley Orgánica 4/2000 – artículo 62 (BOE-A-2024-24099)
fonti.editore: Boletín Oficial del Estado
fonti.nota: Article 62(1): 400% of the IPREM a month for the applicant; 100% of the IPREM a month for each family member, in addition.

programmi.nome_ufficiale: Visto de residência / estada temporária para exercício de atividade profissional prestada de forma remota
programmi.reddito: Average monthly income over the last three months from remote work (employment or self-employment) for clients or employers outside Portugal.
programmi.descrizione: Portugal's visa for remote workers ('digital nomads'), as a residence visa or a temporary stay visa.

varianti.regola: 4 times the minimum monthly wage (RMMG) for the main applicant. For accompanying family members, the Ministry refers to the per-person scale of Ordinance 1563/2007: +50% of the RMMG for each further adult, +30% for each child.

note: The 4 × RMMG amount is the average monthly income of the last three months.

Family amounts: the Ministry's residence visa page asks accompanying family members for means 'under nº 2 of article 2 of Ordinance 1563/2007', which is the per-person scale (50% per further adult, 30% per child). We add that scale on top of 4 × RMMG. Consulates may assess family means differently: check with yours.

fonti.titolo: Residency visa – necessary documentation (remote professional activity: digital nomads; accompanying family members)
fonti.editore: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Portugal
fonti.nota: Proof of average monthly income for the last three months of at least four monthly minimum guaranteed remunerations; family members: means under Ordinance 1563/2007, art. 2(2).

fonti.titolo: Means of subsistence – National visas
fonti.editore: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Portugal
fonti.nota: RMMG 2026: €920; first adult 100%, further adults 50%, children 30%.

programmi.nome_ufficiale: Visto de residência para reformados, religiosos ou pessoas que vivam de rendimentos
programmi.reddito: Stable and regular income: pension, rents, investments, intellectual property. The Ministry's scale is net of social security deductions.
programmi.descrizione: Portugal's residence visa for retirees and people living on passive income.

varianti.regola: 100% of the minimum monthly wage (RMMG) for the first adult, 50% for each further adult, 30% for each child under 18 (or dependent adult child).

note: Means must cover the period of stay or 12 months, whichever is shorter: 12 × €920 = €11,040 for one person.
This is the legal minimum. Consulates can ask for more evidence (for example savings in a Portuguese bank account).

fonti.titolo: Means of subsistence – National visas
fonti.editore: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Portugal
fonti.nota: Minimum monthly salary in 2026: €920; first adult 100%, second and additional adults 50%, children under 18 and non-minor dependent children 30%.

fonti.titolo: Residency visa – retirement, religious purposes or people living from passive income
fonti.editore: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Portugal
fonti.nota: Documents certifying the pension or the passive income; family members under Ordinance 1563/2007.

programmi.reddito: Regular income shown by bank statements or payslips for the last six months (or the total amount for the whole stay in your account).
programmi.descrizione: Croatia's temporary stay for digital nomads, up to 18 months.

varianti.regola: 2.5 average monthly net salaries of the previous year for the main applicant; +10% of the average monthly net salary for each family member or partner.

note: Instead of a monthly income you can show the whole amount in your bank account: €43,470 for 12 months or €65,205 for 18 months (main applicant, Ministry figures).
The +10% is 10% of one average net salary (€144.90), not 10% of €3,622.50.

fonti.titolo: Temporary stay of digital nomads
fonti.editore: Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Croatia (MUP)
fonti.nota: At least 2.5 average monthly net salaries of the previous year; currently €3,622.50 a month; +10% of the average monthly net salary for each additional family member or partner; €43,470 for 12 months, €65,205 for 18 months.

programmi.reddito: Net monthly income from a foreign employer or your own profitable foreign company, in each of the 6 months before entry.
programmi.descrizione: Hungary's residence permit for digital nomads, valid one year and renewable once.

varianti.regola: At least €3,000 net a month in each of the 6 months before entry, and throughout the stay.

famiglia.motivo: Family members of a White Card holder cannot get a residence permit for family reunification (Immigration Office page).

note: You must keep this income for the whole stay.
You cannot work for a Hungarian employer or own shares in a Hungarian company.

fonti.titolo: Fehér Kártya – digitális nomád tartózkodás (information sheet)
fonti.editore: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF), Hungary
fonti.nota: Means are proven if the lawful income reached at least €3,000 net a month in the 6 months before entry; family members of a White Card holder cannot get a residence permit for family reunification.

programmi.nome_ufficiale: Visto per nomadi digitali e lavoratori da remoto
programmi.reddito: Minimum annual income from lawful sources.
programmi.descrizione: Italy's visa for highly qualified remote workers and digital nomads (decree of 29 February 2024, Official Gazette no. 79 of 4 April 2024).

varianti.regola: At least three times the minimum income level for exemption from healthcare co-payments: 3 × €8,263.31 = €24,789.93 a year.

famiglia.motivo: The decree sets no per-person amount for family members: it allows family reunification under article 29 of the Consolidated Immigration Act, which has its own income test. Ask the consulate.

note: Other requirements in the decree: health insurance, accommodation, at least six months' experience in the work you will do remotely, and a contract or binding offer for highly qualified work.
The decree does not say whether the income is gross or net.

fonti.titolo: Decreto 29 febbraio 2024 – Modalità e requisiti per l'ingresso ed il soggiorno dei cittadini di Stati non appartenenti all'Unione europea che svolgono un'attività lavorativa altamente qualificata da remoto (G.U. Serie Generale n. 79 del 4 aprile 2024)
fonti.editore: Gazzetta Ufficiale della Repubblica Italiana
fonti.nota: Art. 3: minimum annual income from lawful sources not lower than three times the minimum level for exemption from healthcare co-payments; family reunification under art. 29 of the Consolidated Act.

programmi.reddito: Gross annual salary including special payments (13th and 14th salary).
programmi.descrizione: Austria's EU Blue Card for university graduates with a binding job offer.

base.etichetta: average gross annual income of full-time employees, 2026

varianti.regola: At least the average gross annual income of full-time employees: €55,678 in 2026 (annual salary plus special payments).

famiglia.motivo: The Blue Card threshold is a salary for the job holder: it does not increase with family members.

note: Austrian salaries are usually paid 14 times a year, so the monthly payslip is about the annual amount ÷ 14; our monthly figure is the annual amount ÷ 12.
A labour market test also applies.

fonti.nota: In 2026 at least €55,678 (annual salary plus special payments).

programmi.reddito: Gross annual salary from an approved UK sponsor.
programmi.descrizione: The UK's main work visa for jobs with an approved employer.

varianti.regola: At least £41,700 a year, or the going rate for your occupation if higher.

famiglia.motivo: The salary rule is for the worker: it does not increase with family members (dependants have separate requirements).

varianti.nome: Lower rate (when you can be paid less)
varianti.regola: At least £33,400 a year in the cases where GOV.UK says you can be paid less (outside healthcare and education).

famiglia.motivo: The salary rule is for the worker: it does not increase with family members (dependants have separate requirements).

note: Each occupation code has its own going rate: if it is higher than £41,700, the going rate applies.
Healthcare and education jobs follow national pay scales.

fonti.titolo: Skilled Worker visa: your job
fonti.editore: GOV.UK (Home Office)
fonti.nota: Standard salary rate at least £41,700 per year or the going rate, whichever is higher; at least £33,400 when you can be paid less.

programmi.reddito: Combined income of you and your partner (savings can sometimes be used instead).
programmi.descrizione: The UK family visa for a partner or spouse of a British citizen or settled person.

varianti.regola: Combined income of at least £29,000 a year.

famiglia.motivo: For new applications GOV.UK states one amount, £29,000, with no extra amount for children.

varianti.nome: Extension, first applied as a partner before 11 April 2024
varianti.regola: Combined income of at least £18,600 a year, plus £3,800 for the first child and £2,400 for each further child who needs it; never more than £29,000 in total.

note: Children who are British or Irish citizens, or settled, do not need extra money.
There is no income requirement if your partner receives certain disability or carer's benefits.

fonti.titolo: Family visas: apply, extend or switch – financial requirements if you're applying as a partner or spouse
fonti.editore: GOV.UK (Home Office)
fonti.nota: Combined income at least £29,000 a year; extending (first applied before 11 April 2024): £18,600, plus £3,800 for the first child and £2,400 for each additional child, capped at £29,000.
